components.name: Company knowledge
components.what: Roles, steps, cases, files, rules and skills — learned from approved records, never typed in.

components.name: Team simulator
components.what: Replays the same team, requests and luck under a different plan. Step times and waits fit to your records.

components.name: Demand model
components.what: Ranks where your kind of business grows next, from public data around each site. One industry code switches it.

limits.title: Revenue per location
limits.why: Last year’s local figure predicts it as well as the model does. Flowline ranks where demand grows, not exact sales.

limits.title: Where doctors should open
limits.why: Population alone does as well. Shown, not hidden.

limits.title: Contract redlines
limits.why: Only 3 approved records so far. Needs 10 before it is simulated.
